features.name: Turn SIFT indexes on or off from Business Central client
features.description: Administrators can now manage SIFT indexes directly from the Business Central application, turning them on or off based on performance analysis and storage requirements. This capability extends the index management experience introduced in 2026 Release Wave 1.
caveats: SIFT management is application-level, not direct SQL Server modification

features.name: Index Management page
features.description: A dedicated page where administrators can view all indexes for tables, including statistics such as fragmentation, size, seeks, scans, lookups, and last update times. Provides information on whether indexes are AL-defined or platform-defined, and whether they are enabled in the database.
caveats: Unique keys and primary keys cannot be toggled

features.name: Index type classification
features.description: The index management experience now shows the type of index - either a secondary key in SQL Server or a SIFT which is an aggregation of numeric values against a key.

features.name: Company-level index control
features.description: Administrators can enable or disable indexes at the company level, allowing different companies in a multi-company environment to have different index configurations based on their specific workloads and performance requirements.
caveats: Provides granular control but requires understanding of company-specific workloads

features.name: Database index management at application level
features.description: 2026 release wave 1 introduced application level database index management through table information, allowing administrators to manage indexes without needing to modify AL code.

features.name: Immediate index disable with deferred enable
features.description: Disabling a SIFT or index happens immediately, but enabling an index is deferred to the next overnight maintenance cycle in local time to avoid slowing down operations.
caveats: Timing depends on tenant local time
